text_block_list.text:
At the summer festival held near the 
training lodge, T.M. Opera O was in top 
form even there at the venue.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho, look at that stall! Stuck into that 
very spot is the legendary Choco-Banana 
Sword!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
We must pluck it out and rescue the 
goldfish immediately! Let us burn away the 
soba and octopus alike!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Mommy, Mommy! That girl over there is so 
funny!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text: Shh, you shouldn't look...

Just as I was getting hyped up all by 
myself...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Um... Trainer-san. And Opera O-san too!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
This festival is nice and all, but aren't 
you two going to participate? In this 
summer's biggest festival of all, that is.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The grandest festival...? Grass-kun, what 
might that be? A fireworks display, 
perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, it's something even more amazing than 
fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My classmate, El Condor Pasa... El is 
about to run a race. It's being broadcast 
live from overseas.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It just so happens to take place during 
our training camp, so we were all talking 
about watching it together.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: El's race! Of course I'll watch it!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see, the previous generation is already 
overseas... This is something I must 
spectate by all means!

And on the day of the race— the viewing 
venue was buzzing with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Go get 'em! El-chan, El-cha...
(WOOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAY!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is El Condor Pasa!! It's El 
Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Japanese Umamusume can compete in Europe 
too! She has brilliantly blown open the 
doors of tradition!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah... Aaaaah, how wonderful!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"To think a Japanese Umamusume could shine 
so brightly in France, the great land of 
opera!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So Opera O-san was cheering for El too, 
wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Cheering? Far from it! I am the one who 
chases down the previous generation and 
surpasses them.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The previous generation, who were already 
strong last year, got even stronger this 
year. That just made me genuinely happy.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"The stronger they are, the more rewarding 
they are to defeat! The tale of their 
overthrow will burn all the brighter!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's only when the villain is superb that 
I, the lead, can shine even more 
elegantly.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, quite the ambitious one, aren't you? 
In that case, neither El nor I will lose 
to you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! I lost to El-chan in last year's 
Japan Cup, but this time for sure!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how reassuring! Truth be told, I have 
already set my heart on the Arima Kinen 
for our showdown with the older 
generation.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So let us have a proper match first. With 
both of you, if possible!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I accept your challenge.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah, with pleasure!

And so, a promise for the end of the year 
was made.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I am looking forward to the main event, 
but since we are together like this...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, I'd like to indulge in a 
match during this summer training camp, 
though."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's fine with me. It'll serve as a 
good workout for me, too.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer?

With an opponent as capable as T.M. Opera 
O, there's no need to hold back at all.

Whatever kind of special training we do, I 
want you to give it everything you've got 
here.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san, who would you rather race 
against— me, or Grass-chan?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, both of them are strong, you know? 
Which one will it be?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, let us seek the judgment of the one I 
place the most trust in.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, if I were to spar with 
someone, which one do you think would be 
better?

With her powerful acceleration, Special 
Week possesses a burst of explosive speed.

Grass Wonder, on the other hand, is said 
to have a fierce inner fighting spirit and 
excel in close-quarters duels.

What would be helpful for T.M. Opera O 
is...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That would be me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All right, then tomorrow instead of 
regular practice, let's do that!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Opera O-san, time for our 
part-time job at the beach hut.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoever puts up the most parasols, carries 
the most boats, and brings the most joy to 
everyone wins!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
W-What?! Carrying a boat that big too? 
Don't tell me...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Back in Hokkaido, you're no good if you 
can't lift a tractor stuck in a ditch, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If you can't even carry that much, you'll 
never beat us!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, Hokkaido is a force to be reckoned 
with! Truly the kingdom of wetlands and 
root vegetables!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then I shall see it through, as a 
true Part-Time Workerienne! Uoooh!

Not to be outdone by Special Week, TM 
Opera O breaks a sweat at her part-time 
job.

It proved to be a valuable learning 
experience, and seems to have bolstered 
their strength as well.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Me, right? I'd be happy to accept♪ But 
simply running wouldn't have much flair, 
would it...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Let's make it a race worthy of a training 
camp. Yes, for example—
(Meeen-meeen-meeen)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now, it is time for a haikai duel under 
the scorching sun. Endure the heat... and 
recite your poem.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Singing in this sweltering heat? 
What a cruel outdoor theater...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A true opera of torture! Is this the sheer 
power of the previous generation?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Allow me to go first.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"On the summer breeze, Fly to France, my 
cherished hopes, Carry all my heart."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, here you go...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, it's so hot... I can't think of 
anything.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this scorching oblivion... will 
make for a novel spice!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Overlord... The enduring Overlord is 
so beautiful..."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: There's no seasonal word (kigo) in here.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Summer Overlord Sweat-drenched, radiant 
and grand Utterly divine..."

Her taste is peculiar, as usual... Still, 
through her haiku boot camp with Grass 
Wonder, she seems to have developed real 
grit.
